citations.text: SEV1 triage: page the incident commander, freeze deploys, open the war-room, post the first status update within 5 minutes. Confirm blast radius before any mitigation.
Rollback runbook: identify the last known-good deploy, flip the release flag or redeploy the pinned artifact, verify health checks pass, then announce all-clear in the war-room feed.
Handoff template: outgoing states what changed, what is suspected, and what is next; incoming ACKs explicitly. Close returns 409 until the ACK lands.
